seo.title: Devendra Milmile - Full Stack Developer | Angular & .NET Core
seo.description: Full stack developer in Pune with 7+ years of Angular and .NET Core work. I build web apps, micro frontends, and the APIs behind them.
seo.keywords: Full Stack Developer, Angular Developer, .NET Core Developer, Devendra Milmile, Web Developer, Micro Frontends, React Developer, TypeScript

hero.name: Devendra Milmile
hero.title: Full Stack Developer
hero.description: I've been building web apps with Angular and .NET Core for over 7 years. These days that mostly means micro frontends, and moving old monoliths onto them.

skills.description: Most of my work is Angular on the front end and .NET Core on the back end. Here's the rest of what I use.

experience.description: Four companies since 2019. Most of that time went into Angular front ends and the .NET Core APIs behind them.

description: Moving a legacy monolith onto a micro frontend architecture as part of a replatform project
Joined in January 2026, so this list is still short
Built an Angular micro frontend app that several products run on
Maintained a shared Angular library so each app didn't rebuild the same components
Worked on .NET Core APIs sitting behind a YARP reverse proxy
Wrote service aggregators that combine several backend calls into one endpoint
Worked in agile sprints with cross-functional teams
Shipped several full-stack projects on Angular, .NET Core, and SQL Server
Built reusable UI components with Angular Material and PrimeNG
Sped up API responses by adding caching and gzip compression
Led a team of 3 developers and 1 QA on UNIDO DIPS
Recognized for delivering on time without cutting corners on quality
Built full-stack features for healthcare and service-business apps
Built a PDF form builder and an appointment calendar module from scratch
Talked with clients directly to pin down requirements
Was the go-between for clients and the dev team

projects.title: Samyo
projects.description: My own SaaS for small event businesses in India: balloon decorators, DJs, photographers, stage and lighting crews. It replaces the paper booking diary with one app for bookings, equipment, payments, and team assignments.
highlights: Reminders on WhatsApp, email, or push 7 days, 2 days, and 4 hours before each event
Equipment checklists generated from the services each business offers
Works offline at the venue and installs on a phone
Interface in English, Hindi, and Marathi

projects.title: Bright Horizons - College Coach
projects.description: Moving a legacy monolith onto micro frontends, with Angular 19 on the front end and .NET 9 behind it. Part of the job is pulling duplicated components into one shared UI library.
highlights: Breaking a monolith into micro frontends backed by new .NET 9 services
Moved copy-pasted components into a shared UI library, so every micro frontend behaves the same and bugs get fixed in one place

projects.title: CLARIO - Public API Platform
projects.description: A public API on .NET 8, with YARP routing requests to the services underneath. I also built a notification rule engine and an Expression Designer library that lets users define their own triggers.
highlights: Custom Swagger UI for the API docs
Notification rule engine built as a micro frontend
Expression Designer library with a visual editor
YARP reverse proxy setup

projects.title: UNIDO DIPS
projects.description: Full-stack web app with multi-language support, external surveys, and JWT auth. I led a team of 3 developers and 1 QA.
highlights: Multi-language support
External surveys built on Survey.js
JWT authentication for the web APIs
Led the team from kickoff through delivery

projects.title: SymphonyAI Platform
projects.description: An Angular library of shared components and navigation used across SymphonyAI products. I also built a drag-and-drop dashboard with configurable charts.
highlights: Customer engagement up 25%
Drag-and-drop dashboard built on Angular Gridster2
Configurable charts with AmCharts5
Menus driven by JSON config

projects.title: @datelane/core
projects.description: An Angular scheduler and calendar library with no runtime dependencies. Date handling is pluggable, so it works with native Dates, Luxon, or Moment. MIT licensed and on npm.
highlights: Published on npm
Pluggable date adapters: Native, Luxon, Moment
Zero runtime dependencies
Scheduler, calendar, timeline, and agenda views

projects.title: ngx-custom-carousel
projects.description: An open source Angular carousel that renders whatever template you hand it. Releases follow semver and publish automatically through GitHub Actions. I stopped maintaining it in August 2026.
highlights: Published on npm
Semantic versioning
CI/CD with GitHub Actions
Renders custom Angular templates
